records.name: Diaphragm and Cut-Off Valve Kit MSP 25/33
records.kind: official manufacturer exact-code source and make-level application
records.note: WABCO Customer Centre official exact-material confirmation (300025033): WABCO identifies this as “Kit: Diaphragm + Cut-Off Valve” with India vehicle applications TATA, Ashok Leyland, Volvo Eicher (VECV), Daimler (Bharat Benz) and MAN, for a twin-cylinder 704 cc flange-mounted compressor. This is manufacturer make-level evidence only, not an individual chassis/model list. Confirm the Souviks product contents, compressor family and actuator configuration against the WABCO kit drawing before supplying. Source: https://www.wabco-customercentre.com/catalog/en_IN/300025033

records.name: Drying and Distribution Unit
records.kind: official manufacturer exact-code and technical application
records.note: WABCO Customer Centre official exact-material confirmation (100304941): identified as “DDU-(VOSS)” with India vehicle application TATA, intended for the twin-cylinder 704 cc flange-mounted compressor. The official data specifies a desiccant cartridge, 8.5 bar cut-out pressure, four M22 × 1.5 ports and −40 °C to +85 °C operating range. This confirms Tata make-level application only; verify VOSS connection layout, silencer and installed DDU model before assigning an individual truck. Source: https://www.wabco-customercentre.com/catalog/en/100304941
